A bow commonly found amongst military archers.

Effective against Flying units.

A basic medicinal brew common amongst soldiers, adventurers and mercenaries. Leaves a bitter aftertaste.

A mighty sword meant to be wielded with two hands by one with impressive physique. 

Heavybreaker
